description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Travelers is hiring participants for its one-year Engineering Development Program in the Software track. Participants build technical and self-leadership skills through hands-on engineering work, training, and mentoring while contributing to software solutions and technology platforms.
Software Engineering Development Program participant designing and implementing software solutions and supporting infrastructure platforms with AI-assisted tools

Responsibilities:
• Travelers’ Software Engineers contribute to the overall software design strategy by planning, developing, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, documenting, and implementing software solutions that enable our products, distribution workflows, customer, agent, and employee experiences
• EDP participants in this track will have duties that vary based on the specific opportunities presented within each experience. These experiences include leveraging modern software engineering and analytic tools and practices, design, deliver, and support state-of-the-art and high performing infrastructure platforms and services enabling business operations and technology solutions. You will leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms, applying critical thinking to evaluate the limitations, quality, and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs
• Additional program components include mentoring, networking, and career guidance
• Please note that occasional travel for business meetings and events is an expectation of program participants
• Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future
• The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role
• You are a self-starter who goes beyond required job or educational commitments to explore new technologies, applications, and environments
• You take strong ownership of your actions, performance, and outcomes, proactively managing your time while juggling multiple projects simultaneously
• You collaborate effectively and maintain a positive attitude whether working independently or as part of a team
• You also demonstrate strong analytical aptitude—identifying current or future problems and opportunities, synthesizing and comparing data, recognizing cause-and-effect relationships, and exploring alternative solutions to support sound decision-making
• Suggested majors include (but not limited to): Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline
• Exposure to object-oriented programming (OOP) in one or more major languages
• Experience with algorithms, data structures, systems design, and networking
• Knowledge of APIs and Web Development i.e. use of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Eventing and modern front-end technologies such as React, NextJS, etc
• Familiarity with relational databases and SQL, as well as an awareness of NoSQL/document database concepts
• Bachelor's or Master's degree or completion of licensed/accredited technical bootcamp

Preferred:
• Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or greater preferred
